description: This PHP class defines the 'AgeGroup' filter field used in reporting within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterField class and implements filtering logic based on employee age groups, utilizing date difference calculations through Doctrine's query builder.

classes.name: AgeGroup
classes.description: A filter field for age-based queries in the report system, supporting operators like less than, greater than, and between.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds age-based filtering conditions to the Doctrine query builder based on the selected operator and age range.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity alias(es) used for query joins in this filter.
